content: Comparable retail trading tools (Tradesyncer, QuantWheel, tradeSteward) show connection health with a status icon per account: green/healthy link icon vs yellow warning ('Tokens Stale') vs broken-link icon ('Not linked'/'Disconnected'). An expiration banner appears ahead of the deadline (seen for Schwab-connected products). Re-auth is a popup/redirect back through the broker's own login, not a custom form. Source: Tradesyncer, QuantWheel, tradeSteward help docs (vendor support docs, MEDIUM).
